kurz: Whisk egg whites or cream hard until a firm foam forms. Knowing the right moment to stop is crucial.
bild_im_kopf: Like blowing up balloons: fine up to the right size, beyond that they burst.
was_passiert: At first, large, irregular bubbles form. Over time they get smaller and more even, and the foam turns stiff. Keep whisking and the proteins contract too much; the foam turns grainy and watery.
schritte: Put the egg whites in a clean, grease-free bowl.
Start slowly until foamy, then add a pinch of acid.
Whisk faster until soft peaks form.
Stop when the foam is stiff and glossy.
